event_name: Piano Legends: The Charleston Jazz Orchestra
event_description:
Piano Legends celebrates and explores the rich legacy of iconic pianists throughout Jazz history. Spanning the evolution of jazz from Ragtime to Modern Fusion, the Charleston Jazz Orchestra will present the styles and innovations of legendary jazz pianists such as Herbie Hancock, Chick Corea, Thelonious Monk and Bill Evans, to showcase how this grandiose instrument shaped the genre’s emotional and harmonic language.

\n

event_name: What a Wonderful World: Bruce Harris + The Charleston Jazz Orchestra
event_description:
Louis Armstrong is considered one of the most important, if not the most important figure in the history of Jazz. His energetic and rhythmic playing has been a major influence on soloists of every genre of American popular music. Louis’ soaring trumpet and gravelly voice were made world famous with such favorites as Hello Dolly, Mack the Knife, Cheek to Cheek, and What a Wonderful World. Trumpet phenom Bruce Harris is an internationally renowned musician and educator and is Artistic Director of Programs at the Louis Armstrong House Museum in New York City. Throughout his career, Bruce has collaborated with many artists, to include Wynton Marsalis, Tony Bennett, Dave Brubeck and Samara Joy. On this special evening, Bruce joins the Charleston Jazz Orchestra for a Celebration of ‘Satchmo’ and the amazing music he created for the world to enjoy!

\n

event_description:
Acclaimed alto saxophonist Vincent Herring brings his fiery, soulful artistry to Charleston for an evening of straight-ahead jazz at its finest. A celebrated collaborator of Wynton Marsalis, Art Blakey, and Freddie Hubbard, and co-creator of the Cannonball Adderley Legacy Band, Herring joins the Charleston Jazz Orchestra for a program rooted in the traditions of soul jazz, blues, and bebop.
